approvalReason: Repeated across 29 Brightspace sidecar candidates; high-value operating pattern for bounded Codex delegation.

promotedPattern.name: bounded_codex_handoff
promotedPattern.summary: A bounded Codex handoff must give the receiving agent enough scope, evidence requirements, and stop conditions to act without inventing context or broadening the task.

expectedFutureBehaviorChange: Future Codex prompts include repo path, task objective, inspection targets, allowed and forbidden actions, acceptance criteria, stop condition, and proof return requirements.
